title: Gliding without flapping
hook: A glide can move a bird forward as it descends.

knows: Birds have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The dotted path slopes downward as the bird moves forward. In this simplified still-air glide, falling height reduces gravitational potential energy; the diagram does not specify the bird’s speed or all energy losses.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: In still air, a bird glides without flapping and loses height. Which energy store falls?
